details: Verified 5 varied payload types (empty, short, 1KB, binary bytes, UTF-8 unicode).
Bit flip in ciphertext rejected by Poly1305 AEAD tag authentication.
Modified authentication tag correctly triggers integrity failure.
Blobs < 28 bytes (12B nonce + 16B tag) rejected before cipher initialization.
HKDF-SHA256 generates unique 32-byte keys for each (user, file) pair; cross-user decryption fails.
Generated 200 distinct 12-byte nonces with zero collisions.
Empty or missing token correctly raises HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
Expired JWT rejected with HTTP 401 'Token has expired'.
Forged JWT with wrong signature secret raises HTTP 401.
assert_owns_resource strictly raises HTTP 403 when current_user['sub'] != resource_user_id.
User A's attempts to view or generate signed URLs for User B's documents return 403 Forbidden.
Unauthorized document deletion by cross-tenant actor correctly rejected with 403 Forbidden.
System prompt explicitly mandates closed-world evidence grounding and abstention phrasing.
Telemetry log format confirmed strictly numerical/metadata; no API keys, bearer tokens, or document text present.
